title: Minkah Fitzpatrick Pittsburgh Steelers 2023 Panini Prizm Football Card 250
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm Football Card features Minkah Fitzpatrick of the Pittsburgh Steelers and Alabama Crimson Tide. The card is a part of the base set and has a card number of 250. It is a standard-sized card with a premium foil stock finish. 

The card is unsigned and does not have any autographs. It is a great addition to any football trading card collection and perfect for fans of the National Football League (NFL). Get your hands on this card and add it to your collection today!
